+            raise ValueError(
+                "MuseSpark1x AITER output has shape "
+                f"{tuple(output.shape)}, expected {expected_output_shape}."
+            )
+
+        expanded_hidden_states = take_expanded(hidden_states, top_k)
+        if expanded_hidden_states is None:
+            expanded_hidden_states = (
+                hidden_states[:, None, :]
+                .expand(num_tokens, top_k, hidden_dim)
+                .reshape(num_tokens * top_k, hidden_dim)
+                .contiguous()
+            )
+        # Only the shape of topk_ids is read after the experts.
+        num_routes = num_tokens * top_k
+        flat_topk_ids = topk_ids.view(num_routes, 1)
+        if expert_map is not None:
+            # AITER's EP convention: one extra route per row on the always-masked
+            # last expert_mask slot; its tuned-config lookup subtracts it.
+            masked_slot = flat_topk_ids.new_full(
+                (num_routes, 1), expert_map.shape[0] - 1
+            )
+            flat_topk_ids = torch.cat((flat_topk_ids, masked_slot), dim=1)
+        unit_topk_weights = self._unit_weights(
+            num_routes, flat_topk_ids.shape[1], topk_ids.device
+        )
+
+        if expert_tokens_meta is not None:
+            num_local_tokens = expert_tokens_meta.expert_num_tokens
+        else:
+            num_local_tokens = None
+
+        route_output = rocm_aiter_fused_experts(
+            hidden_states=expanded_hidden_states,
+            w1=w1,
+            w2=w2,
+            topk_weights=unit_topk_weights,
+            topk_ids=flat_topk_ids,
+            activation=activation,
+            expert_mask=expert_map,
+            quant_config=self.quant_config,
+            moe_config=self.moe_config,
+            a1q_scale=a1q_scale,
+            num_local_tokens=num_local_tokens,
+            output_dtype=output.dtype,
+            moe_sorting_dispatch_policy=rocm_aiter_ops.get_moe_dispatch_policy(),
+            apply_router_weight_on_input=False,
+        )
+        self._park_route_output(route_output.view_as(output))
+
+    def finalize_weight_and_reduce_impl(self) -> mk.TopKWeightAndReduce:
+        quant_config = self.quant_config
+        assert isinstance(quant_config, MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXMoEQuantConfig)
+        assert quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn is not None
+        return MuseSparkTopKWeightAndReduce(
+            quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn,
+            pre_norm_all_reduce=self.moe_config.moe_parallel_config.tp_size > 1,
+            take_route_output=self._take_route_output,
+        )
+
+
+class MuseSparkQuarkW8A8Fp8FusedMoE(QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod):
+    """Quark W8A8 FP8 method using route-preserving Triton experts."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        moe: FusedMoEConfig,
+        weight_quant_key: QuantKey,
+        activation_quant_key: QuantKey | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        validate_fp8_deployment(moe)
+        super().__init__(moe, weight_quant_key, activation_quant_key)
+        if self.fp8_backend is not Fp8MoeBackend.TRITON:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x FP8 on ROCm requires the Triton FP8 MoE backend; "
+                f"got {self.fp8_backend.value}."
+            )
+        self.experts_cls = MuseSparkTritonExperts
+
+    def get_fused_moe_quant_config(
+        self, layer: RoutedExperts
+    ) -> MuseSparkQuarkFp8MoEQuantConfig:
+        base_config = super().get_fused_moe_quant_config(layer)
+        post_expert_norm_fn = getattr(layer, "post_expert_norm_fn", None)
+        if post_expert_norm_fn is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("MuseSpark1x post-expert norm is not configured.")
+        return MuseSparkQuarkFp8MoEQuantConfig(
+            **{
+                f.name: getattr(base_config, f.name)
+                for f in fields(FusedMoEQuantConfig)
+                if f.init
+            },
+            post_expert_norm_fn=post_expert_norm_fn,
+        )
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: RoutedExperts) -> None:
+        loaded_slots = getattr(layer, "_quark_expert_loaded_slots", None)
+        if loaded_slots is not None:
+            _validate_quark_expert_weights(
+                loaded_slots, layer.moe_config.num_logical_experts
+            )
+            del layer._quark_expert_loaded_slots
+        super().process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+
+
+class MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE(QuarkOCP_MX_MoEMethod):
+    """Quark W4A4 method using route-preserving stock AITER experts."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        moe: FusedMoEConfig,
+        weight_quant_key: QuantKey,
+        activation_quant_key: QuantKey | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        validate_mxfp4_deployment(moe)
+        super().__init__(moe, weight_quant_key, activation_quant_key)
+        if self.ocp_mx_scheme != "w_mxfp4_a_mxfp4":
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x MXFP4 on ROCm requires Quark OCP W4A4 with "
+                f"dynamic MXFP4 activations; got {self.ocp_mx_scheme!r}."
+            )
+        if self.mxfp4_backend is not Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x MXFP4 on ROCm requires the "
+                "AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4 backend; got "
+                f"{self.mxfp4_backend.value}."
+            )
+        self.experts_cls = MuseSparkAiterExperts
+
+    def get_fused_moe_quant_config(
+        self, layer: RoutedExperts
+    ) -> MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXMoEQuantConfig:
+        base_config = super().get_fused_moe_quant_config(layer)
+        if base_config is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("MuseSpark1x MXFP4 quant config is not initialized.")
+        post_expert_norm_fn = getattr(layer, "post_expert_norm_fn", None)
+        if post_expert_norm_fn is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("MuseSpark1x post-expert norm is not configured.")
+        return MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXMoEQuantConfig(
+            **{
+                f.name: getattr(base_config, f.name)
+                for f in fields(FusedMoEQuantConfig)
+                if f.init
+            },
+            post_expert_norm_fn=post_expert_norm_fn,
+        )
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: RoutedExperts) -> None:
+        loaded_slots = getattr(layer, "_quark_expert_loaded_slots", None)
+        if loaded_slots is not None:
+            _validate_quark_expert_weights(
+                loaded_slots, layer.moe_config.num_logical_experts
+            )
+            del layer._quark_expert_loaded_slots
+        super().process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+
+
+_QUARK_EXPERT_PROJECTIONS = {
+    "gate_proj": ("w13_weight", "w1"),
+    "up_proj": ("w13_weight", "w3"),
+    "down_proj": ("w2_weight", "w2"),
+}
+
+
+def _quark_expert_weight_slot(name: str) -> tuple[str, str, int] | None:
+    parts = name.split(".")
+    if len(parts) != 3 or not parts[0].isdigit():
+        return None
+    projection = _QUARK_EXPERT_PROJECTIONS.get(parts[1])
+    if projection is None or parts[2] not in ("weight", "weight_scale"):
+        return None
+    param_name, shard_id = projection
+    if parts[2] == "weight_scale":
+        param_name += "_scale"
+    return param_name, shard_id, int(parts[0])
+
+
+def _expected_quark_expert_weight_slots(
+    num_experts: int,
+) -> set[tuple[str, str, int]]:
+    return {
+        (param_name, shard_id, expert_id)
+        for expert_id in range(num_experts)
+        for param_name, shard_id in (
+            ("w13_weight", "w1"),
+            ("w13_weight", "w3"),
+            ("w2_weight", "w2"),
+            ("w13_weight_scale", "w1"),
+            ("w13_weight_scale", "w3"),
+            ("w2_weight_scale", "w2"),
+        )
+    }
+
+
+def _track_quark_expert_weights(
+    weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]],
+    loaded: set[tuple[str, str, int]],
+) -> Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """Track expert tensors across the loader's independently grouped calls."""
+    for name, tensor in weights:
+        slot = _quark_expert_weight_slot(name)
+        if slot is not None:
+            if slot in loaded:
+                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate MuseSpark1x expert tensor {name!r}.")
+            loaded.add(slot)
+        yield name, tensor
+
+
+def _validate_quark_expert_weights(
+    loaded: set[tuple[str, str, int]],
+    num_experts: int,
+) -> None:
+    expected = _expected_quark_expert_weight_slots(num_experts)
+    missing = expected - loaded
+    if missing:
+        loaded_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
+        for param_name, shard_id, _ in loaded:
+            key = f"{param_name}:{shard_id}"
+            loaded_counts[key] = loaded_counts.get(key, 0) + 1
+        preview = ", ".join(
+            f"{param_name}:{shard_id}:expert{expert_id}"
+            for param_name, shard_id, expert_id in sorted(missing)[:8]
+        )
+        if len(missing) > 8:
+            preview += f", ... ({len(missing)} total)"
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Missing MuseSpark1x Quark expert tensors: "
+            f"{preview}; loaded slot counts: {loaded_counts}"
+        )
+
+    unexpected = loaded - expected
+    if unexpected:
+        preview = ", ".join(
+            f"{param_name}:{shard_id}:expert{expert_id}"
+            for param_name, shard_id, expert_id in sorted(unexpected)[:8]
+        )
+        if len(unexpected) > 8:
+            preview += f", ... ({len(unexpected)} total)"
+        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected MuseSpark1x Quark expert tensors: {preview}")
+
+
+class MuseSparkRoutedExperts(MuseSparkConsolidatedRoutedExperts):
+    """MuseSpark routed experts using ROCm BF16, FP8, or MXFP4 methods."""
+
+    def _get_quant_method(
+        self,
+        prefix: str,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        moe_config: FusedMoEConfig,
+    ) -> FusedMoEMethodBase:
+        if quant_config is None:
+            return MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE(moe_config)
+        if not isinstance(quant_config, QuarkConfig):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x on ROCm supports BF16, Quark FP8, or Quark OCP-MXFP4 "
+                f"checkpoints; got {quant_config.get_name()!r}."
+            )
+
+        quant_method = quant_config.get_quant_method(self, prefix)
+        if isinstance(quant_method, UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod):
+            return MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE(moe_config)
+        if isinstance(quant_method, QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod):
+            return MuseSparkQuarkW8A8Fp8FusedMoE(
+                moe_config,
+                quant_method.weight_quant_key,
+                quant_method.activation_quant_key,
+            )
+        if not isinstance(quant_method, QuarkOCP_MX_MoEMethod):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x on ROCm requires Quark W8A8 FP8 or OCP-MXFP4 for routed "
+                f"experts; got {type(quant_method).__name__}."
+            )
+        return MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE(
+            moe_config,
+            quant_method.weight_quant_key,
+            quant_method.activation_quant_key,
+        )
+
+    def load_weights(
+        self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]
+    ) -> Iterable[str]:
+        if not isinstance(
+            self.quant_method,
+            (MuseSparkQuarkW8A8Fp8FusedMoE, MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE),
+        ):
+            # Quark's unquantized layers (0 and 61) store per-expert tensors.
+            consolidated: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]] = []
+            per_expert: list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]] = []
+            for name, tensor in weights:
+                if _quark_expert_weight_slot(name) is None:
+                    consolidated.append((name, tensor))
+                else:
+                    per_expert.append((name, tensor))
+            if consolidated:
+                yield from super().load_weights(consolidated)
+            if per_expert:
+                yield from RoutedExperts.load_weights(self, per_expert)
+            return
+
+        loaded_slots = getattr(self, "_quark_expert_loaded_slots", None)
+        if loaded_slots is None:
+            loaded_slots = set()
+            self._quark_expert_loaded_slots = loaded_slots
+        tracked_weights = _track_quark_expert_weights(weights, loaded_slots)
+        yield from RoutedExperts.load_weights(self, tracked_weights)
+
+
+class MuseMoERunner(MoERunner):
+    """MoE runner whose custom reducer owns the TP reduction."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *args,
+        post_expert_norm: torch.nn.Module,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        if not isinstance(self.routed_experts, MuseSparkRoutedExperts):
+            raise TypeError(
+                "MuseMoERunner requires routed_experts_cls=MuseSparkRoutedExperts."
+            )
+        self.routed_experts.post_expert_norm_fn = post_expert_norm.forward
+
+    @property
+    def _fused_output_is_reduced(self) -> bool:
+        return needs_pre_norm_all_reduce(self.moe_config)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "MuseMoERunner",
+    "MuseSpark1xRouter",
+    "MuseSparkAiterExperts",
+    "MuseSparkQuarkFp8MoEQuantConfig",
+    "MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXFusedMoE",
+    "MuseSparkQuarkW8A8Fp8FusedMoE",
+    "MuseSparkRoutedExperts",
+    "MuseSparkTopKWeightAndReduce",
+    "MuseSparkTritonExperts",
+    "validate_bf16_deployment",
+    "validate_fp8_deployment",
+    "validate_mxfp4_deployment",
+]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Pre-expert RMSNorm written once per route, in the ``[T * top_k, H]`` layout
+the ROCm MXFP4 (AITER top-1 per route) experts take."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+# Set on the returned first-route view; holds the full expanded buffer.
+_EXPANDED_ATTR = "_muse_route_expanded"
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rmsnorm_expand_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    D: tl.constexpr,
+    eps,
+    gain_center,
+    REPEATS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    INPUT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    d = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
+    dm = d < D
+    x = tl.load(x_ptr + t * D + d, mask=dm, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT:
+        w = tl.load(w_ptr + d, mask=dm, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) + gain_center
+        if INPUT_SCALE:
+            x = x * w
+    y = x * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) * (1.0 / D) + eps)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT and not INPUT_SCALE:
+        y = y * w
+    y = y.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+    for r in tl.static_range(REPEATS):
+        tl.store(out_ptr + (t * REPEATS + r) * D + d, y, mask=dm)
+
+
+def fused_rmsnorm_expand(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    eps: float,
+    gain_center: float,
+    input_scale: bool,
+    repeats: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """RMSNorm of ``x`` written ``repeats`` times per row."""
+    assert x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()
+    T, D = x.shape
+    out = torch.empty((T, repeats, D), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    if T > 0:
+        block_d = triton.next_power_of_2(D)
+        _rmsnorm_expand_kernel[(T,)](
+            x,
+            weight if weight is not None else x,
+            out,
+            D=D,
+            eps=eps,
+            gain_center=gain_center,
+            REPEATS=repeats,
+            BLOCK_D=block_d,
+            HAS_WEIGHT=weight is not None,
+            INPUT_SCALE=input_scale and weight is not None,
+            num_warps=8 if block_d >= 4096 else 4,
+        )
+    first = out[:, 0]
+    setattr(first, _EXPANDED_ATTR, out)
+    return first
+
+
+def take_expanded(hidden_states: torch.Tensor, repeats: int) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """The ``[T * repeats, D]`` buffer behind a :func:`fused_rmsnorm_expand`
+    result, or ``None`` if ``hidden_states`` is not one."""
+    out = getattr(hidden_states, _EXPANDED_ATTR, None)
+    if (
+        out is None
+        or out.data_ptr() != hidden_states.data_ptr()
+        or out.shape != (hidden_states.shape[0], repeats, hidden_states.shape[1])
+        or hidden_states.stride() != (repeats * hidden_states.shape[1], 1)
+    ):
+        return None
+    return out.view(-1, hidden_states.shape[1])

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""FP32-exact router GEMM on bf16 matrix cores.
+
+Three bf16 planes sum exactly to the fp32 weight; split-K sums in fixed order.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+# (max tokens, BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, BLOCK_K, splits, num_warps), tuned on MI350X
+# for the Muse router shape (N=256, K=8192).
+_CONFIGS = (
+    (16, 16, 32, 128, 32, 2),
+    (64, 64, 32, 128, 32, 2),
+    (128, 64, 32, 128, 16, 2),
+    (256, 64, 64, 128, 16, 4),
+    (1024, 128, 64, 128, 16, 8),
+    (4096, 128, 128, 64, 8, 8),
+    (None, 128, 128, 64, 4, 8),
+)
+
+
+def _config(num_tokens: int) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int]:
+    for max_tokens, *cfg in _CONFIGS:
+        if max_tokens is None or num_tokens <= max_tokens:
+            return tuple(cfg)  # type: ignore[return-value]
+    raise AssertionError("unreachable")
+
+
+def supports_router_bf16x3(num_experts: int, hidden_size: int) -> bool:
+    return all(
+        num_experts % bn == 0 and hidden_size % (splits * bk) == 0
+        for _, _, bn, bk, splits, _ in _CONFIGS
+    )
+
+
+def split_fp32_to_bf16x3(weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``[3, N, K]`` bf16 planes whose sum is ``weight`` (fp32) exactly."""
+    assert weight.dtype == torch.float32
+    hi = weight.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    rest = weight - hi.float()
+    mid = rest.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    lo = (rest - mid.float()).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    return torch.stack([hi, mid, lo]).contiguous()
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _router_bf16x3_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    part_ptr,
+    M,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    K_PER_SPLIT: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid_n = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_k = tl.program_id(1)
+    pid_m = tl.program_id(2)
+    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    m_mask = offs_m < M
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for kk in range(0, K_PER_SPLIT, BLOCK_K):
+        offs_k = pid_k * K_PER_SPLIT + kk + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+        a = tl.load(
+            x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * K + offs_k[None, :],
+            mask=m_mask[:, None],
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        w_tile = w_ptr + offs_n[None, :] * K + offs_k[:, None]
+        for p in tl.static_range(3):
+            acc = tl.dot(a, tl.load(w_tile + p * N * K), acc)
+    tl.store(
+        part_ptr + (pid_k * M + offs_m[:, None]) * N + offs_n[None, :],
+        acc,
+        mask=m_mask[:, None],
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _reduce_splits_kernel(
+    part_ptr, out_ptr, MN, SPLITS: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr
+):
+    offs = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = offs < MN
+    acc = tl.load(part_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    for s in tl.static_range(1, SPLITS):
+        acc += tl.load(part_ptr + s * MN + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + offs, acc, mask=mask)
+
+
+def router_bf16x3_gemm(x: torch.Tensor, planes: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``x @ (planes[0] + planes[1] + planes[2]).T`` in fp32."""
+    assert x.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and x.is_contiguous()
+    m, k = x.shape
+    n = planes.shape[1]
+    assert planes.shape == (3, n, k)
+    out = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    if m == 0:
+        return out
+    block_m, block_n, block_k, splits, num_warps = _config(m)
+    part = torch.empty((splits, m, n), dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    _router_bf16x3_kernel[(n // block_n, splits, triton.cdiv(m, block_m))](
+        x,
+        planes,
+        part,
+        m,
+        N=n,
+        K=k,
+        K_PER_SPLIT=k // splits,
+        BLOCK_M=block_m,
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=block_k,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+    )
+    block = 1024
+    _reduce_splits_kernel[(triton.cdiv(m * n, block),)](
+        part, out, m * n, SPLITS=splits, BLOCK=block, num_warps=4
+    )
+    return out

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Waveform AutoEncoder for MuseSpark raw audio input.
+
+Each patch of 1920 samples (80 ms @ 24 kHz) yields one latent token.
+"""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import (
+    ColumnParallelLinear,
+    RowParallelLinear,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import maybe_prefix
+
+
+def patchify(x: torch.Tensor, patch_size: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Group consecutive timesteps: [B, T, D] -> [B, T // p, p * D]."""
+    b, t, d = x.shape
+    assert t % patch_size == 0, f"t={t} is not divisible by patch_size={patch_size}"
+    return x.reshape(b, t // patch_size, patch_size * d)
+
+
+class Patchifier(nn.Module):
+    """Patchify -> Linear -> RMSNorm."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        patch_size: int,
+        d_input: int,
+        d_output: int,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        disable_tp: bool = True,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.patch_size = patch_size
+        self.linear = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            input_size=d_input * patch_size,
+            output_size=d_output,
+            bias=True,
+            gather_output=True,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "linear"),
+            disable_tp=disable_tp,
+        )
+        self.norm = RMSNorm(d_output, eps=norm_eps)
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x = patchify(x, self.patch_size)
+        x, _ = self.linear(x)
+        return self.norm(x)
+
+
+class DepthwiseCausalConv(nn.Module):
+    """Depthwise causal 1-D convolution with optional streaming cache."""
+
+    def __init__(self, d_model: int, kernel_size: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self._kernel_size = kernel_size
+        self.conv = nn.Conv1d(
+            in_channels=d_model,
+            out_channels=d_model,
+            kernel_size=kernel_size,
+            stride=1,
+            padding=0,
+            bias=True,
+            groups=d_model,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        cache: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        """[B, T, D] -> [B, T, D]; ``cache`` is [B, D, kernel_size - 1] or None."""
+        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)  # [B, D, T]
+
+        if cache is None:
+            x = F.pad(x, (self._kernel_size - 1, 0))
+            x = self.conv(x)
+            new_cache = None
+        else:
+            x = torch.cat((cache, x), dim=-1)
+            if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+                # CUDA-graph safe: in-place update.
+                cache.copy_(x[:, :, -self._kernel_size + 1 :])
+                new_cache = cache
+            else:
+                new_cache = x[:, :, -self._kernel_size + 1 :]
+            x = self.conv(x)
+
+        # The downstream fused RMSNorm kernel requires a contiguous buffer.
+        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1).contiguous()  # [B, T, D]
+        return x, new_cache
+
+
+class Block(nn.Module):
+    """DepthwiseCausalConv -> RMSNorm -> FFN (GELU) with a residual."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        d_model: int,
+        d_hidden: int,
+        kernel_size: int,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        disable_tp: bool = True,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self._d_model = d_model
+        self._kernel_size = kernel_size
+        self.conv = DepthwiseCausalConv(d_model, kernel_size)
+        self.norm = RMSNorm(d_model, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.linear1 = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            input_size=d_model,
+            output_size=d_hidden,
+            bias=True,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "linear1"),
+            disable_tp=disable_tp,
+        )
+        self.linear2 = RowParallelLinear(
+            input_size=d_hidden,
+            output_size=d_model,
+            bias=True,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "linear2"),
+            disable_tp=disable_tp,
+        )
+        self.activation = nn.GELU()
+
+    @property
+    def d_model(self) -> int:
+        return self._d_model
+
+    @property
+    def kernel_size(self) -> int:
+        return self._kernel_size
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        inputs: torch.Tensor,
+        cache: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        x = inputs
+        x, cache = self.conv(x, cache)
+        x = self.norm(x)
+        x, _ = self.linear1(x)
+        x = self.activation(x)
+        x, _ = self.linear2(x)
+        return x + inputs, cache
+
+
+class AutoEncoder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        latent_channels: int,
+        patch_size: int = 1920,
+        kernel_size: int = 7,
+        data_channels: int = 1,
+        patchify_sizes: tuple[int, ...] = (16, 6, 5, 4),
+        d_models: tuple[int, ...] = (256, 512, 1024, 2048),
+        n_layers: tuple[int, ...] = (2, 2, 2, 2),
+        prefix: str = "",
+        disable_tp: bool = True,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+        mlp_ratio: float = 4.0,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.latent_channels = latent_channels
+        self.patch_size = patch_size
+        self.kernel_size = kernel_size
+        self.data_channels = data_channels
+
+        d_model_list = [data_channels] + list(d_models)
+        self.stages = nn.Sequential(
+            *[
+                self._make_stage(
+                    d_input=d_model_list[stage_id],
+                    d_model=d_model_list[stage_id + 1],
+                    patch_size=patchify_sizes[stage_id],
+                    n_layers_count=n_layers[stage_id],
+                    s_kernel=kernel_size,
+                    prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, f"stages.{stage_id}"),
+                    disable_tp=disable_tp,
+                    norm_eps=norm_eps,
+                    mlp_ratio=mlp_ratio,
+                )
+                for stage_id in range(len(n_layers))
+            ]
+        )
+
+        self.norm = RMSNorm(d_model_list[-1], eps=norm_eps)
+        self.o_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            input_size=d_model_list[-1],
+            output_size=latent_channels,
+            bias=True,
+            gather_output=True,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "o_proj"),
+            disable_tp=disable_tp,
+        )
+        self.dual_norm = RMSNorm(latent_channels, eps=norm_eps)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _make_stage(
+        d_input: int,
+        d_model: int,
+        patch_size: int,
+        n_layers_count: int,
+        s_kernel: int,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        disable_tp: bool = True,
+        norm_eps: float = 1e-6,
+        mlp_ratio: float = 4.0,
+    ) -> nn.Sequential:
+        layers: list[nn.Module] = [
+            Patchifier(
+                patch_size,
+                d_input,
+                d_model,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "0"),
+                disable_tp=disable_tp,
+                norm_eps=norm_eps,
+            )
+        ]
+        for i in range(n_layers_count):
+            layers.append(
+                Block(
+                    d_model,
+                    int(d_model * mlp_ratio),
+                    kernel_size=s_kernel,
+                    prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, str(i + 1)),
+                    disable_tp=disable_tp,
+                    norm_eps=norm_eps,
+                )
+            )
+        return nn.Sequential(*layers)
+
+    def _encode_prefill(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Prefill encoding: [B, T, data_channels] -> [B, T', latent_channels]."""
+        for stage in self.stages:
+            for block in stage:
+                if isinstance(block, Patchifier):
+                    x = block(x)
+                elif isinstance(block, Block):
+                    x, _ = block(x, None)
+        x = self.norm(x)
+        x, _ = self.o_proj(x)
+        x = self.dual_norm(x)
+        return x
+
+    def forward(self, wavs: list[torch.Tensor]) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+        """Encode raw waveforms into [num_tokens, latent_channels] embeddings."""
+        if not wavs:
+            return []
+
+        def _pad(wav: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+            wav = wav.reshape(-1, self.data_channels)
+            pad_size = (self.patch_size - wav.shape[0]) % self.patch_size
+            return F.pad(wav, (0, 0, 0, pad_size))
+
+        embeds: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        for wav in wavs:
+            wav_batch = _pad(wav).unsqueeze(0)  # [1, T, C]
+            embed = self._encode_prefill(wav_batch)
+            embeds.append(embed.squeeze(0))  # [num_tokens, latent_channels]
+        return embeds

+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ReplicatedLinear

+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (

+class MuseSparkDSparkDecoderLayer(MuseSpark1xDecoderLayer):
+    """Dense Muse layer with the draft's materialized, gated FP32 residual."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, prefix)
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.self_attn.causal = True
+        if (self.self_attn.rotary_emb is not None) != config.use_rope:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Muse Spark DSpark layers must share their positional mode"
+            )
+
+    def forward(  # type: ignore[override]
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, None]:
+        stream = hidden_states.to(self.residual_dtype)
+        attn_out = self.self_attn(
+            positions=positions,
+            # Round to the draft compute dtype before each trained input norm.
+            hidden_states=self.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm(
+                stream.to(self.default_dtype), out_dtype=self.default_dtype
+            ),
+        )
+        stream = self.add_attn(stream=stream, branch=self.post_attn_norm(attn_out))
+        ffn_out = self.feed_forward(self.pre_ffn_norm(stream.to(self.default_dtype)))
+        stream = self.add_ffn(stream=stream, branch=self.post_ffn_norm(ffn_out))
+        return stream, None
+
+
+@support_torch_compile
+class MuseSparkDSparkModel(DFlashQwen3Model):
+    """Muse draft backbone with independently cached context K/V."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        start_layer_id: int = 0,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+        config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config
+        if not isinstance(config, MuseSparkDSparkConfig):
+            raise TypeError("MuseSparkDSparkModel requires MuseSparkDSparkConfig")
+        self.config = config
+        self.default_dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()
+        self.vocab_size = config.vocab_size
+        self.quant_config = get_draft_quant_config(vllm_config)
+        self.use_aux_hidden_state = True
+        self.target_layer_ids = tuple(config.target_layer_ids)
+        # Avoid rerunning VllmConfig validation against the target's shared configs.
+        draft_config = copy(vllm_config)
+        draft_config.model_config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config
+        draft_config.quant_config = self.quant_config
+
+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "embed_tokens"),
+        )
+        self.mask_token_id = config.mask_token_id
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "mask_embedding",
+            torch.zeros(config.hidden_size, dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype),
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+        self.has_separate_mask_embedding = False
+        self.fc = ReplicatedLinear(
+            input_size=config.target_hidden_size * len(self.target_layer_ids),
+            output_size=config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
+            quant_config=self.quant_config,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "fc"),
+            return_bias=False,
+        )
+        self.hidden_norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            has_weight=config.norm_affine,
+            zero_centered_gamma=config.norm_zero_centered_gamma,
+        )
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            MuseSparkDSparkDecoderLayer(
+                draft_config,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, f"layers.{layer_idx + start_layer_id}"),
+            )
+            for layer_idx in range(config.num_hidden_layers)
+        )
+        self.norm = MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            has_weight=config.norm_affine,
+            zero_centered_gamma=config.norm_zero_centered_gamma,
+        )
+        self.markov_head = DSparkMarkovHead(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.draft_vocab_size,
+            config.markov_rank,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "markov_head"),
+            quant_config=self.quant_config,
+        )
+        self.confidence_head: DSparkConfidenceHead | None = None
+        if config.enable_confidence_head:
+            confidence_width = config.hidden_size + (
+                config.markov_rank if config.confidence_head_with_markov else 0
+            )
+            self.confidence_head = DSparkConfidenceHead(
+                confidence_width,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "confidence_head"),
+                bias=True,
+                with_markov=config.confidence_head_with_markov,
+            )
+
+    def _build_fused_kv_buffers(self) -> None:
+        layers_attn = [layer.self_attn for layer in self.layers]
+        attn0 = layers_attn[0]
+        self._context_pre_norms = tuple(attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm for attn in layers_attn)
+        self._stacked_kv_weight = torch.stack(
+            [
+                attn.qkv_proj.weight[attn.q_size : attn.q_size + 2 * attn.kv_size]
+                for attn in layers_attn
+            ],
+            dim=0,
+        )
+        self._num_attn_layers = len(layers_attn)
+        self._kv_size = attn0.kv_size
+        self._head_dim = attn0.head_dim
+        self._num_kv_heads = attn0.num_kv_heads
+        self._rms_norm_eps = attn0.qk_norm.variance_epsilon
+        self._rotary_emb = attn0.rotary_emb
+        self._attn_layers = [attn.attn for attn in layers_attn]
+        for attn in layers_attn[1:]:
+            if (
+                attn.kv_size != self._kv_size
+                or attn.head_dim != self._head_dim
+                or attn.num_kv_heads != self._num_kv_heads
+                or attn.qk_norm.variance_epsilon != self._rms_norm_eps
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Muse Spark DSpark layers must share KV geometry")
+
+    def _project_muse_context_kv(self, context_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Apply the two trained Muse input norms, then each layer's K/V map."""
+        fc_output = self.hidden_norm(context_states)
+        per_layer_context = torch.stack(
+            [norm(fc_output) for norm in self._context_pre_norms], dim=0
+        )
+        return torch.bmm(per_layer_context, self._stacked_kv_weight.transpose(1, 2))
+
+    def precompute_and_store_context_kv(
+        self,
+        context_states: torch.Tensor,
+        context_positions: torch.Tensor,
+        context_slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor | None] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not hasattr(self, "_num_attn_layers"):
+            self._build_fused_kv_buffers()
+        num_ctx = context_states.shape[0]
+        num_layers = self._num_attn_layers
+        all_kv_flat = self._project_muse_context_kv(context_states)
+        all_kv = (
+            all_kv_flat.view(
+                num_layers,
+                num_ctx,
+                2,
+                self._num_kv_heads,
+                self._head_dim,
+            )
+            .permute(2, 0, 1, 3, 4)
+            .contiguous()
+        )
+        all_k = all_kv[0]
+        all_v = all_kv[1]
+        k_fp32 = all_k.float()
+        variance = k_fp32.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        all_k = (k_fp32 * torch.rsqrt(variance + self._rms_norm_eps)).to(all_k.dtype)
+        all_k_flat = all_k.view(
+            num_layers * num_ctx, self._num_kv_heads, self._head_dim
+        )
+        if self._rotary_emb is not None:
+            positions = context_positions.repeat(num_layers)
+            all_k_flat, _ = self._rotary_emb(
+                positions,
+                all_k_flat,
+                # CUDA RoPE updates both operands in place. Aliasing the same
+                # context-key tensor as Q and K rotates it twice.
+                None,
+            )
+        if context_slot_mapping is None:
+            return
+        all_k = all_k_flat.view(num_layers, num_ctx, self._num_kv_heads, self._head_dim)
+        per_layer = isinstance(context_slot_mapping, (list, tuple))
+        for layer_idx, attn in enumerate(self._attn_layers):
+            slot_mapping = (
+                context_slot_mapping[layer_idx] if per_layer else context_slot_mapping
+            )
+            if slot_mapping is None:
+                continue
+            attn.impl.do_kv_cache_update(
+                attn,
+                all_k[layer_idx],
+                all_v[layer_idx],
+                attn.kv_cache,
+                slot_mapping,
+            )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        input_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states = (
+            self.embed_input_ids(input_ids) if input_embeds is None else input_embeds
+        )
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.to(self.config.residual_dtype)
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden_states, _ = layer(positions, hidden_states, None)
+        return self.norm(hidden_states.to(self.default_dtype))
+
+
+class MuseSparkDSparkForCausalLM(Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM):
+    """Muse DSpark head with the target's output-distribution transform."""
+
+    has_own_lm_head = True
+
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_stacked={
+            ".self_attn.q_proj.": (".self_attn.qkv_proj.", "q"),
+            ".self_attn.k_proj.": (".self_attn.qkv_proj.", "k"),

+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:

+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        model_weights = {}
+        includes_lm_head = False
+        includes_d2t = False

+            orig_to_new_stacked=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper.orig_to_new_stacked,
+        )
+        loaded = AutoWeightsLoader(self).load_weights(
+            model_weights.items(), mapper=mapper
+        )
+        self.model._build_fused_kv_buffers()
+        materialize_residual_path_constants(self.model)

+"""Platform-neutral Common MuseSpark1x layers and residual connections."""
+
+import math
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ColumnParallelLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import QuantizationConfig
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.ops.fused_rmsnorm import fused_rmsnorm_fwd
+
+
+def calculate_gain_center(
+    gain_center_type: str,
+    residual_id: int,
+    n_layers: int | None = None,
+) -> float:
+    """Gain center for the given type and residual ID (1-based indices)."""
+    if gain_center_type == "one":
+        return 1.0
+    if gain_center_type == "zero":
+        return 0.0
+    if gain_center_type == "inverse_residual_index":
+        return 1.0 / (2 * math.ceil(residual_id / 2))
+    if gain_center_type in (
+        "inverse_residual_index_v2",
+        "inverse_residual_index_p1",
+    ):
+        return 1.0 / (residual_id + 1)
+    if gain_center_type == "inverse_sqrt_residual_index":
+        return 1.0 / math.sqrt(2 * math.ceil(residual_id / 2))
+    if gain_center_type == "inverse_sqrt_layers":
+        assert n_layers is not None, "n_layers must be provided for this option."
+        return 1.0 / math.sqrt(n_layers)
+    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported gain_center_type: {gain_center_type}")
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xRMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    """RMSNorm in fp32, rounded once at the store to ``out_dtype``.
+
+    Deliberately not ``F.rms_norm``: that path can flip greedy token selection.
+    """
+
+    # Which side of the normalization the weight lands on; read by fused kernels.
+    applies_weight_before_norm = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        eps: float = 1e-6,
+        var_hidden_size: int | None = None,
+        has_weight: bool = True,
+        is_post_norm: bool = False,
+        zero_centered_gamma: bool = False,
+        post_norm_gain_center_type: str = "one",
+        residual_id: int | None = None,
+        output_norm_gain_center_type: str = "zero",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.variance_epsilon = eps
+        self.variance_size_override = (
+            None if var_hidden_size == hidden_size else var_hidden_size
+        )
+        self.has_weight = has_weight
+        if self.has_weight:
+            self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(hidden_size), requires_grad=False)
+        else:
+            self.weight = None
+
+        self.zero_centered_gamma = zero_centered_gamma
+        self.gain_center = 1.0
+        if residual_id is not None and is_post_norm:
+            self.gain_center = calculate_gain_center(
+                post_norm_gain_center_type, residual_id
+            )
+        elif residual_id == -1:
+            self.gain_center = calculate_gain_center(
+                output_norm_gain_center_type, residual_id
+            )
+
+    @property
+    def fused_gain_center(self) -> float:
+        """``gain_center`` as the fused kernels take it: 0.0 when unused."""
+        return self.gain_center if self.has_weight and self.zero_centered_gamma else 0.0
+
+    def forward_native(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        out_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        orig_dtype = x.dtype
+        out_dtype = out_dtype or orig_dtype
+        x = x.to(torch.float32)
+        if residual is not None:
+            x = x + residual.to(torch.float32)
+            residual = x.to(orig_dtype)
+
+        hidden_size = x.shape[-1]
+        if hidden_size != self.hidden_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Expected hidden_size to be "
+                f"{self.hidden_size}, but found: {hidden_size}"
+            )
+
+        if self.variance_size_override is None:
+            x_var = x
+        else:
+            if hidden_size < self.variance_size_override:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Expected hidden_size to be at least "
+                    f"{self.variance_size_override}, but found: {hidden_size}"
+                )
+            x_var = x[..., : self.variance_size_override]
+
+        variance = x_var.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+
+        x = x * torch.rsqrt(variance + self.variance_epsilon)
+        if self.has_weight:
+            weight = self.weight.float()
+            if self.zero_centered_gamma:
+                weight = weight + self.gain_center
+            x = x * weight
+        x = x.to(out_dtype)
+        if residual is None:
+            return x
+        return x, residual
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        out_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if residual is None and self.supports_fused_kernel(x):
+            return fused_rmsnorm_fwd(
+                x,
+                self.weight if self.has_weight else None,
+                self.variance_epsilon,
+                out_dtype=out_dtype,
+                gain_center=self.fused_gain_center,
+                input_scale=self.applies_weight_before_norm and self.has_weight,
+                # Only matters past one 8192-element tile; a device query here
+                # would break the compiled graph.
+                use_kahan_summation=True,
+            )
+        return self.forward_native(x, residual, out_dtype)
+
+    def supports_fused_kernel(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+        """Whether the Triton kernel can serve this norm for input ``x``."""
+        return (
+            self.variance_size_override is None
+            and x.is_contiguous()
+            and x.shape[-1] == self.hidden_size
+        )
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale(MuseSpark1xRMSNorm):
+    """Weight-first RMSNorm variant: ``rms_norm(x * weight)``."""
+
+    applies_weight_before_norm = True
+
+    def forward_native(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        out_dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        orig_dtype = x.dtype
+        out_dtype = out_dtype or orig_dtype
+        x = x.to(torch.float32)
+        if residual is not None:
+            x = x + residual.to(torch.float32)
+            residual = x.to(orig_dtype)
+
+        if self.weight is not None:
+            weight = self.weight.float()
+            if self.zero_centered_gamma:
+                weight = weight + self.gain_center
+            x = x * weight
+        x = F.rms_norm(x, (self.hidden_size,), None, self.variance_epsilon)
+        x = x.to(out_dtype)
+
+        if residual is None:
+            return x
+        return x, residual
+
+
+class MulTanhSoftCap(nn.Module):
+    """Computes ``soft_cap_temp * tanh(x * multiplier / soft_cap_temp)`` in fp32."""
+
+    def __init__(self, multiplier: float, soft_cap_temp: float) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.multiplier = multiplier
+        self.soft_cap_temp = soft_cap_temp
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        assert x.dtype in (torch.float32, torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)
+        if x.is_cuda and x.is_contiguous():
+            if x.dtype != torch.float32:
+                x = x.float()
+            return ops.muse_spark_mul_tanh_soft_cap(
+                x, self.multiplier, self.soft_cap_temp
+            )
+        x = x.float() * self.multiplier
+        return self.soft_cap_temp * torch.tanh(x / self.soft_cap_temp)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xResidualConnection(nn.Module):
+    """Vanilla residual sum: ``stream + branch``."""
+
+    def forward(self, stream: torch.Tensor, branch: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return stream + branch.to(stream.dtype)
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection(MuseSpark1xResidualConnection):
+    """Gated residual sum with norm-preserving weights: ``alpha*a + beta*b``.
+
+    With ``a`` the stream and ``b`` the branch, and gate parameter ``w``:
+
+        beta = sigmoid(w / temperature)
+        alpha = sqrt(max(eps, sigmoid(-w) * (1 + beta)))   # = sqrt(1 - beta^2)
+
+    The sum is computed in fp32 and cast back to the stream dtype.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        dim: int,
+        activation: str = "sigmoid",
+        temperature: float = 0.3,
+        use_stream_gate: bool = True,
+        channel_wise: bool = True,
+        eps: float = 1e-3,
+    ):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.activation_type = activation
+        self.temperature = temperature
+        self.use_stream_gate = use_stream_gate
+        self.gate = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(dim if channel_wise else 1))
+
+    def coefficients(
+        self, w: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor | float, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Compute post-activation coefficients for the stream and branch."""
+        if self.activation_type != "sigmoid":
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported activation: {self.activation_type}")
+        beta = torch.sigmoid(w)
+        if self.use_stream_gate:
+            alpha_sq = torch.sigmoid(-w) * (1.0 + beta)  # = 1 - beta^2 (stable)
+            alpha = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(alpha_sq, min=self.eps))
+        else:
+            alpha = 1.0
+        return alpha, beta
+
+    def materialize_coefficients(self) -> None:
+        """Cache alpha/beta as fp32 buffers. Call once, after weight loading."""
+        w = self.gate.detach().float() / self.temperature
+        alpha, beta = self.coefficients(w)
+        self.register_buffer("beta", beta.contiguous(), persistent=False)
+        if isinstance(alpha, torch.Tensor):
+            self.register_buffer("alpha", alpha.contiguous(), persistent=False)
+        else:
+            self.alpha = alpha
+        self._coefficients_ready = True
+
+    def forward(self, stream: torch.Tensor, branch: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        dtype = stream.dtype
+        branch = branch.to(dtype)
+
+        if getattr(self, "_coefficients_ready", False):
+            alpha, beta = self.alpha, self.beta
+        else:
+            w = self.gate.view(*([1] * (stream.ndim - 1)), -1).float()
+            alpha, beta = self.coefficients(w / self.temperature)
+        out = alpha * stream + beta * branch
+        return out.to(dtype)
+
+
+@dataclass(slots=True)
+class MuseSpark1xResidualStream:
+    """A residual stream whose last blend is deferred to fuse with the next norm."""
+
+    stream: torch.Tensor
+    branch: torch.Tensor
+    post_norm: MuseSpark1xRMSNorm
+    connection: MuseSpark1xResidualConnection
+
+
+def norm_then_gated_residual(x: MuseSpark1xResidualStream) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``alpha * stream + beta * norm(branch)``, in one kernel where possible."""
+    norm, connection = x.post_norm, x.connection
+    branch, stream = x.branch, x.stream
+    if (
+        isinstance(connection, MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection)
+        and getattr(connection, "_coefficients_ready", False)
+        and branch.is_cuda
+        and stream.shape == branch.shape
+        and stream.is_contiguous()
+        and norm.supports_fused_kernel(branch)
+    ):
+        return fused_rmsnorm_fwd(
+            branch,
+            norm.weight if norm.has_weight else None,
+            norm.variance_epsilon,
+            gain_center=norm.fused_gain_center,
+            input_scale=norm.applies_weight_before_norm and norm.has_weight,
+            use_kahan_summation=True,
+            residual_stream=stream,
+            alpha=connection.alpha,
+            beta=connection.beta,
+        )
+    return connection(branch=norm(branch), stream=stream)
+
+
+def materialize_residual_path_constants(model: nn.Module) -> int:
+    """Precompute parameter-only constants after weight loading; idempotent."""
+    n_gates = 0
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if isinstance(module, MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection):
+            module.materialize_coefficients()
+            n_gates += 1
+        else:
+            fold = getattr(module, "fold_router_output_multiplier", None)
+            if callable(fold):
+                fold()
+    return n_gates
+
+
+class MuseSpark1xQKVOGateParallelLinear(ColumnParallelLinear):
+    """Fused [Q, K, V, O-gate] projection with head-aware TP sharding.
+
+    Per-rank rows are [q, k, v, o_gate], so checkpoint tensors are sliced by
+    head group. KV-head padding is not supported.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        head_size: int,
+        total_num_heads: int,
+        total_num_kv_heads: int,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        *,
+        tp_rank: int | None = None,
+        tp_size: int | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.head_size = head_size
+        super().__init__(
+            input_size=hidden_size,
+            output_size=2 * (total_num_heads + total_num_kv_heads) * head_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=prefix,
+            tp_rank=tp_rank,
+            tp_size=tp_size,
+        )
+        assert total_num_heads % self.tp_size == 0
+        assert total_num_kv_heads % self.tp_size == 0, (
+            "KV-head padding is not supported for the fused QKV+O-gate "
+            f"projection: {total_num_kv_heads=}, tp_size={self.tp_size}."
+        )
+        self.num_heads = total_num_heads // self.tp_size
+        self.num_kv_heads = total_num_kv_heads // self.tp_size
+
+    def weight_loader(
+        self,
+        param: nn.Parameter,
+        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        loaded_shard_id: str | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if loaded_shard_id is None:
+            assert param.shape == loaded_weight.shape
+            param.data.copy_(loaded_weight)
+            return
+        q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_size
+        kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_size
+        if loaded_shard_id == "q":
+            shard_offset, shard_size = 0, q_size
+        elif loaded_shard_id == "k":
+            shard_offset, shard_size = q_size, kv_size
+        elif loaded_shard_id == "v":
+            shard_offset, shard_size = q_size + kv_size, kv_size
+        elif loaded_shard_id == "o_gate":
+            shard_offset, shard_size = q_size + 2 * kv_size, q_size
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: unknown shard id {loaded_shard_id!r} for the "
+                "fused QKV+O-gate projection."
+            )
+        start_idx = self.tp_rank * shard_size
+        loaded_weight = loaded_weight.narrow(0, start_idx, shard_size)
+        param_shard = param.data.narrow(0, shard_offset, shard_size)
+        assert param_shard.shape == loaded_weight.shape
+        param_shard.copy_(loaded_weight)
+
+    def load_weights(
+        self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]
+    ) -> Iterable[str]:
+        for name, loaded_weight in weights:
+            shard_id = getattr(loaded_weight, "shard_id", None)
+            if name == "bias" and self.bias is None:
+                continue
+            param = getattr(self, name)
+            self.weight_loader(param, loaded_weight, shard_id)
+            yield name
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "MulTanhSoftCap",
+    "MuseSpark1xNormPreservingResidualConnection",
+    "MuseSpark1xQKVOGateParallelLinear",
+    "MuseSpark1xRMSNorm",
+    "MuseSpark1xRMSNormWithInputScale",
+    "MuseSpark1xResidualConnection",
+    "MuseSpark1xResidualStream",
+    "calculate_gain_center",
+    "materialize_residual_path_constants",
+    "norm_then_gated_residual",
+]

+"""Platform-neutral MuseSpark1x MoE pieces: routing, config, expert loading."""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable

+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import (

+)

+
+class MuseSpark1xRouter(BaseRouter):
+    """MuseSpark1x top-k router.
+
+    Optional metap output multiplier -> sigmoid/softmax -> add expert bias for
+    SELECTION only -> top-k -> gather UNBIASED scores -> divide by
+    (sum + division_eps) -> scale by route_scale.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        top_k: int,
+        num_experts: int,
+        expert_bias: torch.Tensor,
+        route_scale: float,
+        router_output_multiplier: float | None = None,
+        router_score_normalization: str = "sigmoid",
+        router_score_division_eps: float | None = None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(top_k=top_k, global_num_experts=num_experts)
+        if router_score_normalization not in ("sigmoid", "softmax"):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Invalid router_score_normalization: {router_score_normalization}"
+            )
+        self.expert_bias = expert_bias
+        self.route_scale = route_scale
+        self.router_output_multiplier = router_output_multiplier
+        self.router_score_normalization = router_score_normalization
+        self.router_score_division_eps = router_score_division_eps
+
+    @property
+    def routing_method_type(self) -> RoutingMethodType:
+        """Classify this router in vLLM's routing vocabulary."""
+        return get_routing_method_type(
+            scoring_func=self.router_score_normalization,
+            top_k=self.top_k,
+            renormalize=True,
+            num_expert_group=None,
+            has_e_score_bias=True,
+        )
+
+    def _compute_routing(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        indices_type: torch.dtype | None,
+        *,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if not router_logits.is_cuda:
+            return self._compute_routing_native(router_logits, indices_type)
+
+        topk_weights, topk_ids = fused_musespark1x_routing(

+            self.expert_bias,
+            self.top_k,
+            self.route_scale,

+            router_score_normalization=self.router_score_normalization,
+            router_score_division_eps=self.router_score_division_eps,
+        )

+        self,

+        gating_output = router_logits
+        if self.router_output_multiplier is not None:
+            gating_output = gating_output * self.router_output_multiplier

+        if self.router_score_normalization == "sigmoid":

+        _, topk_ids = torch.topk(scores_for_topk, self.top_k, dim=-1)
+
+        topk_weights = torch.gather(gating_output, dim=1, index=topk_ids)
+        denom = topk_weights.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        if self.router_score_division_eps is not None:
+            denom = denom + self.router_score_division_eps
+        topk_weights = topk_weights / denom * self.route_scale
+

+            torch.int32 if indices_type is None else indices_type
+        )

+def needs_pre_norm_all_reduce(moe_config: FusedMoEConfig) -> bool:
+    """Whether the GEMM2 rows must be all-reduced before the norm.

+    Under TP the GEMM2 rows are partial sums and RMS is not linear in them.

+    return moe_config.moe_parallel_config.tp_size > 1

+    Vendor subclasses supply ``_get_quant_method``.

+                        weight_name=name,
+                        shard_id="w2",
+                        expert_id=expert_id,
+                    )
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"{self.layer_name}: unsupported expert weight {name!r}"
+                )
+            yield name

+    "MuseSpark1xRouter",
+    "MuseSparkConsolidatedRoutedExperts",

+        embeddings: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        for key, value in kwargs.items():
+            if key == "images":
+                embeddings.extend(
+                    self._encode_vision(
+                        self._process_image_input(
+                            cast(torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor], value),
+                            cast(
+                                torch.Tensor | None,
+                                kwargs.get("image_target_hw"),
+                            ),
+                        )
+                    )
+                )
+            elif key == "videos":
+                embeddings.extend(
+                    self._encode_vision(
+                        self._process_video_input(
+                            cast(torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor], value),
+                            cast(
+                                torch.Tensor | None,
+                                kwargs.get("video_target_hw"),
+                            ),
+                            cast(
+                                torch.Tensor | None,
+                                kwargs.get("video_frame_counts"),
+                            ),
+                        )
+                    )
+                )
+            elif key == "input_features":
+                embeddings.extend(
+                    self._encode_audio(
+                        cast(torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor], value),
+                        cast(
+                            torch.Tensor | None,
+                            kwargs.get("audio_sample_counts"),
+                        ),
+                    )
+                )
+        return embeddings
+
+    def _run_dp_sharded_navit(
+        self,
+        vision_items: list[torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Run NaViT with items load-balanced across TP ranks and one all-gather."""
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        tp_rank = get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
+
+        patch_counts = [self._get_patch_count(item) for item in vision_items]
+
+        shuffle_indices, gpu_sample_counts, gpu_loads = get_load_balance_assignment(
+            patch_counts, tp_size
+        )
+        cum_gpu_sample_counts = [0, *itertools.accumulate(gpu_sample_counts)]
+
+        local_image_indices = shuffle_indices[
+            cum_gpu_sample_counts[tp_rank] : cum_gpu_sample_counts[tp_rank + 1]
+        ]
+        local_vision_items = [vision_items[i] for i in local_image_indices]
+
+        if len(local_vision_items) > 0:
+            local_output = self.vision_model(local_vision_items)
+        else:
+            device = next(self.vision_model.parameters()).device
+            dtype = next(self.vision_model.parameters()).dtype
+            local_output = torch.empty(
+                0, self._adapter_output_dim, device=device, dtype=dtype
+            )
+
+        max_output_per_rank = max(gpu_loads) if max(gpu_loads) > 0 else 0
+
+        current_len = local_output.shape[0]
+        if current_len < max_output_per_rank:
+            padding = torch.empty(
+                max_output_per_rank - current_len,
+                local_output.shape[1],
+                dtype=local_output.dtype,
+                device=local_output.device,
+            )
+            local_output_padded = torch.cat([local_output, padding], dim=0)
+        else:
+            local_output_padded = local_output
+
+        gathered = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(
+            local_output_padded.contiguous(), dim=0
+        )
+
+        original_order = [torch.Tensor()] * len(vision_items)
+        for rank in range(tp_size):
+            rank_start = rank * max_output_per_rank
+            count = gpu_sample_counts[rank]
+            if count == 0:
+                continue
+            rank_image_indices = shuffle_indices[
+                cum_gpu_sample_counts[rank] : cum_gpu_sample_counts[rank + 1]
+            ]
+            embed_offset = rank_start
+            for img_idx in rank_image_indices:
+                img_patches = patch_counts[img_idx]
+                original_order[img_idx] = gathered[
+                    embed_offset : embed_offset + img_patches
+                ]
+                embed_offset += img_patches
+
+        return torch.cat(original_order, dim=0)
+
+    def embed_input_ids(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        multimodal_embeddings: MultiModalEmbeddings | None = None,
+        *,
+        is_multimodal: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Mix vision/audio embeddings into token embeddings.
+
+        Training merges audio before tok_embeddings_norm and vision after it;
+        audio is pre-normed in embed_multimodal, so norming first is equivalent.
+        """
+        h = self.model.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+        h = self.model.tok_embeddings_norm(h)
+
+        if multimodal_embeddings is not None and is_multimodal is not None:
+            h = _merge_multimodal_embeddings(h, multimodal_embeddings, is_multimodal)
+
+        return h
+
+    def get_mm_mapping(self) -> MultiModelKeys:
+        return MultiModelKeys.from_string_field(
+            language_model="model",
+            connector=["vision_projection.", "perception_emb_norm."],
+            tower_model=["vision_model.", "audio_encoder."],
+        )
+
+
+__all__ = ["OMNI_WEIGHTS_MAPPER", "MuseSpark1xOmniMixin", "register_omni_processor"]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Fused MuseSpark post-expert RMSNorm, route weighting and top-k sum."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _post_expert_finalize_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    tw_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    expert_ids_ptr,
+    expert_map_ptr,
+    HAS_EXPERT_MAP: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_ids,
+    idx_ptr,
+    PERMUTED: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_idx,
+    K,
+    H,
+    eps,
+    gain_center,
+    stride_xt,
+    stride_xk,
+    stride_twt,
+    stride_out,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    WEIGHT_FIRST: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    k_mask = k < K
+    h_mask = offs < H
+    tw = tl.load(tw_ptr + t * stride_twt + k, mask=k_mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+    local = k_mask
+    if HAS_EXPERT_MAP:
+        expert = tl.load(expert_ids_ptr + t * stride_ids + k, mask=k_mask, other=-1)
+        local = k_mask & (
+            tl.load(expert_map_ptr + expert, mask=k_mask & (expert >= 0), other=-1) >= 0
+        )
+    if PERMUTED:
+        row = tl.load(idx_ptr + t * stride_idx + k, mask=k_mask, other=-1)
+        local = local & (row >= 0)
+        x_ptrs = x_ptr + row.to(tl.int64)[:, None] * stride_xt + offs[None, :]
+    else:
+        x_ptrs = x_ptr + t * stride_xt + k[:, None] * stride_xk + offs[None, :]
+    x = tl.load(
+        x_ptrs,
+        mask=local[:, None] & h_mask[None, :],
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT:
+        w = tl.load(w_ptr + offs, mask=h_mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) + gain_center
+        if WEIGHT_FIRST:
+            x = x * w[None, :]
+    scale = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(x * x, axis=1) / H + eps) * tw
+    acc = tl.sum(x * scale[:, None], axis=0)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT and not WEIGHT_FIRST:
+        acc = acc * w
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + t * stride_out + offs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=h_mask
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _post_expert_finalize_loop_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    tw_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    expert_ids_ptr,
+    expert_map_ptr,
+    HAS_EXPERT_MAP: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_ids,
+    idx_ptr,
+    PERMUTED: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_idx,
+    K,
+    H,
+    eps,
+    gain_center,
+    stride_xt,
+    stride_xk,
+    stride_twt,
+    stride_out,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    WEIGHT_FIRST: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    t = tl.program_id(0)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    mask = offs < H
+    if HAS_WEIGHT:
+        w = tl.load(w_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) + gain_center
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_H], dtype=tl.float32)
+    x_row = x_ptr + t * stride_xt
+    for k in range(K):
+        local = tl.full((), True, tl.int1)
+        if HAS_EXPERT_MAP:
+            expert = tl.load(expert_ids_ptr + t * stride_ids + k)
+            local = tl.load(expert_map_ptr + expert, mask=expert >= 0, other=-1) >= 0
+        if PERMUTED:
+            row = tl.load(idx_ptr + t * stride_idx + k)
+            local = local & (row >= 0)
+            x_k = x_ptr + row.to(tl.int64) * stride_xt
+        else:
+            x_k = x_row + k * stride_xk
+        x = tl.load(x_k + offs, mask=mask & local, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        if HAS_WEIGHT and WEIGHT_FIRST:
+            x = x * w
+        var = tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) / H
+        y = x * (1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps))
+        if HAS_WEIGHT and not WEIGHT_FIRST:
+            y = y * w
+        tw = tl.load(tw_ptr + t * stride_twt + k).to(tl.float32)
+        acc += y * tw
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr + t * stride_out + offs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask
+    )
+
+
+def fused_post_expert_finalize(
+    routed: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    gain_center: float,
+    weight_first: bool,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    expert_map: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    permuted_idx: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``out[t] = sum_k tw[t, k] * norm(routed[t, k])`` written in ``out.dtype``.
+
+    Routes with a negative ``expert_map`` entry or ``permuted_idx == -1`` were
+    never written and are masked before the read.
+    """
+    if expert_map is not None:
+        assert topk_ids is not None and topk_ids.stride(1) == 1
+    if permuted_idx is not None:
+        assert permuted_idx.dtype == torch.int32 and permuted_idx.stride(1) == 1
+        T, K = permuted_idx.shape
+        H = routed.shape[-1]
+        stride_xt, stride_xk = routed.stride(0), 0
+    else:
+        T, K, H = routed.shape
+        stride_xt, stride_xk = routed.stride(0), routed.stride(1)
+    assert routed.stride(-1) == 1 and out.stride(1) == 1
+    assert topk_weights.stride(1) == 1
+    assert out.shape == (T, H) and topk_weights.shape == (T, K)
+    if T == 0:
+        return out
+    block_h = triton.next_power_of_2(H)
+    assert block_h <= 16384, "row too wide for the single-tile finalize"
+    block_k = triton.next_power_of_2(K)
+    tiled = block_k * block_h <= 65536
+    kernel = (
+        _post_expert_finalize_kernel if tiled else _post_expert_finalize_loop_kernel
+    )
+    tile_kwargs = {"BLOCK_K": block_k} if tiled else {}
+    kernel[(T,)](
+        routed,
+        weight if weight is not None else routed,
+        topk_weights,
+        out,
+        topk_ids if topk_ids is not None else topk_weights,
+        expert_map if expert_map is not None else topk_weights,
+        expert_map is not None,
+        topk_ids.stride(0) if topk_ids is not None else 0,
+        permuted_idx if permuted_idx is not None else topk_weights,
+        permuted_idx is not None,
+        permuted_idx.stride(0) if permuted_idx is not None else 0,
+        K,
+        H,
+        eps,
+        gain_center,
+        stride_xt,
+        stride_xk,
+        topk_weights.stride(0),
+        out.stride(0),
+        BLOCK_H=block_h,
+        HAS_WEIGHT=weight is not None,
+        WEIGHT_FIRST=weight_first,
+        num_warps=8 if (block_k * block_h if tiled else block_h) >= 4096 else 4,
+        **tile_kwargs,
+    )
+    return out

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Muse-Spark QK-norm + RoPE + KV-cache insert as one launch.
+
+Not a custom op since ``MuseSpark1xModel`` is ``@ignore_torch_compile``;
+re-enabling compile requires hiding the forward-context lookup from dynamo.
+"""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.attention import get_attention_context
+
+# nvfp4 pages a different layout and keeps the unfused path.
+SUPPORTED_KV_CACHE_DTYPES = frozenset(
+    {"auto", "bfloat16", "float16", "fp8", "fp8_e4m3", "fp8_e5m2"}
+)
+
+
+def supports_fused_kv_insert(attn_layer: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
+    """Whether this attention layer's backend and cache can take the insert.
+
+    The backend must keep its KV write out of ``forward``. Off under DCP, whose
+    FlashInfer prefill attends over the raw new-token k/v.
+    """
+    parallel_config = get_current_vllm_config().parallel_config
+    if parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size > 1:
+        return False
+    if attn_layer.attn_backend.forward_includes_kv_cache_update:
+        return False
+    if not attn_layer.attn_backend.supports_kv_cache_update_bypass:
+        return False
+    if attn_layer.kv_sharing_target_layer_name is not None:
+        return False
+    return attn_layer.kv_cache_dtype in SUPPORTED_KV_CACHE_DTYPES
+
+
+def fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert(
+    qkv: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor | None,
+    layer_name: str,
+    num_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    rotary_dim: int,
+    eps: float,
+) -> None:
+    """Normalize/rotate QK and insert KV into the attention cache."""
+    _, attn_layer, kv_cache, slot_mapping = get_attention_context(layer_name)
+
+    # No cache bound (profiling) or no slots: skip the insert, still norm+rotate.
+    insert = slot_mapping is not None and kv_cache.numel() > 0
+    insert_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if insert:
+        kv_cache_dtype = attn_layer.kv_cache_dtype
+        is_fp8 = kv_cache_dtype not in ("auto", "bfloat16", "float16")
+        insert_kwargs = {
+            "slot_mapping": slot_mapping,
+            "kv_cache": kv_cache,
+            "block_size": kv_cache.shape[2],
+            "kv_cache_dtype": kv_cache_dtype,
+            "k_scale": attn_layer._k_scale if is_fp8 else None,
+            "v_scale": attn_layer._v_scale if is_fp8 else None,
+        }
+
+    ops.fused_muse_spark_qknorm_rope_kv_insert(
+        qkv,
+        positions,
+        num_heads,
+        num_kv_heads,
+        head_dim,
+        eps,
+        cos_sin_cache=cos_sin_cache,
+        rotary_dim=rotary_dim,
+        **insert_kwargs,
+    )
